description.narrative: The purpose of the pilot project is to address mental health challenges amongst youths in Zambia through various information awareness activities. Mental health is highly stigmatized and is considered a taboo subject in the majority of the African communities, and specifically in Zambia. Through this project we aim to create and normalise the conversation on mental health as a means of reducing the stigma and prejudice around the topic. Secondly this project aims to address the structural barriers such as lack of mental health facilities, lack of qualified personnel, and lack of access to proper treatment and follow-up. Creating the conversation and normalising the discussion around mental health alone, won’t be enough if people don’t have access to facilities where they can get the help they need. The project will therefore work hand in hand with the ministry of health, which is the primary duty-bearer, to outline practical ways to simplify access to treatment and help, for those who need it.
